description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named CacheAbuser that provides a user interface for creating cache file abuse by writing large amounts of data into internal and external cache directories. It includes buttons to start quick or slow cache abuse jobs and a button to stop ongoing jobs. The abuse is implemented via asynchronous tasks that continuously write to files, simulating cache usage or abuse scenarios.

classes.name: CacheAbuser
classes.description: Main activity class that manages UI buttons and background tasks for inducing cache file abuse on an Android device.

classes.name: AbuseTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass responsible for continuously writing data into cache files, either quickly or slowly, to simulate cache abuse.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines button click behaviors.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; updates UI button states.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when the activity is no longer visible; stops any ongoing abuse tasks.

methods.name: stopAbuse
methods.description: Cancels ongoing abuse tasks and updates UI buttons.

methods.name: updateButtonState
methods.description: Enables or disables buttons based on the current state of abuse tasks.
